workloads.name: high_load
workloads._comment: Closed-loop concurrency sweep: 3 profiles c16/c32/c64, all pattern=closed_loop (--request-rate inf; steady saturation holding exactly c in flight — NOT bursty arrivals), no rate_per_s. high_load score = geomean of request_throughput at the 3 concurrency levels. Measures closed-loop THROUGHPUT CAPACITY; does NOT measure arrival-pattern robustness, tail-latency, or SLO. (mid-high-concurrency throughput, not peak — valid as a same-c ratio-to-baseline).
